treatment-approaches.alt: Six rows, each an approach to treatment, what it targets and example techniques. Psychodynamic: unconscious conflicts; free association, dream interpretation. Humanistic: blocked growth; person-centered therapy with active listening and unconditional positive regard. Behavioral: learned behaviors and fears; exposure, systematic desensitization, aversion therapy, token economy. Cognitive: distorted thoughts; cognitive restructuring, REBT. Cognitive-behavioral: thoughts and behaviors together; CBT, DBT. Biomedical: brain chemistry and activity; medication, TMS, ECT, rarely psychosurgery.
